'''thehooky hiden base beat down!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[thehooky]]
* '''Published:''' 22 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 HB thehooky LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits They're On Dantooine (V), Advanced Preparation (V), Luke's Back (V), Son Of Skywalker (V), Yoda (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Bright Hope (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

i made this deck the night before state and it wooped up!! there really is nothing they the dark side can do! it covers every deck tipe they dark can through at you!!

The published list has 62 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 62 as published: the 'Starting: 8' section lists 10 cards (the '(hiden base)' line is a marker, not a card). The two alternative lines '(proton torpedoes, death star trench, attack run) or (more shealds or planets, hiden base)' and the 'traid outs / traid ins' lists are not applied.
* Uncertain nicknames: 'super lando' dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel and 'super chewy' dested Chewbacca, Protector (read as the Reflections super-rare versions).
* Jedi Tests #1/#2 dested Great Warrior / A Jedi's Strength. tatooine EP1 dested Tatooine (Tatooine set); coruscant SE dested Coruscant; <>swamp dested Swamp; leias blaster dested Leia's Blaster Rifle (Leia's Sporting Blaster is the alternative). rebel planners is unmarked, so it is the printed card.
* Original-era (V): Luke's Back (V) (Virtual Set 2); They're On Dantooine (V), Advanced Preparation (V) (Virtual Set 3); General Carlist Rieekan (V) (Virtual Set 4); Son Of Skywalker (V), Yoda (V) (Virtual Set 5); Bright Hope (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* ovs_pick returned Virtual Set 7+ pages for Son Of Skywalker (V) (VS24), Yoda (V) (VS7) and General Carlist Rieekan (V) (VS8) because sets 7+ are treated as legal from 2004-06-01; the code comment says 'only after 2004', so the newest Virtual Set 1-6 printing is used.

== Strategy ==

this deck is the BOMB!!!

i made it a day before state and it wooped up 2nd in state! what cost me the game was deploying the swamp to dantooine and not haveing a nudj there to stop them from comeing, i had no space!! i feel and know it is worlds ready! tell me what you think!

turn 1:

pull Gen rieekan, activate at least 3 force,use one force to pull a squadren, deploy dagobah and pull yodas hut, deploy tatooine, if you can drop bright hope to the point and drop rieekan there.

turn 2: activate 9 force, use 1 force to pull squadren. deploy dantooine, use rieekan to deploy the swamp there and pull nudj to the swamp, pull dag:swamp and deploy aquris, drop super chewy or corn horn to the swamp.

turn 3: activate 13 force, use 1 force to pull a squadren pull tibrin, pull kessil, deploy. normaly i am setting up for the jedi test by the 2nd or 3rd turn.

turn 4: activate 15(20 if qui-gon yoda and you control aquaris), deploy coruscant SE flip and apliy your beat down for a win.

the best feeling in this game is when they have a couple ties at cloud city and you drop 6 ywings on him!!! did that two games in a row at state, i feel just fine takeing on the executer!

if you like you could go alot more space and less ground, you can stop all his force drains and his force drain bonuses. and its not like he can battle you in space! with that much force you can drop 4-5 or more ywing squads each turn, nothing he can do to that much power!

i will tell you why i use some of the cards i am useing in the deck.

the only thing that can kill this deck is spys, the <>swamp is what makes this deck tick, the swamp will deploy only to dantooine so you can deploy your squadrens. never deploy the swamp tell you have a nudj ready to drop on it to cancle there icon, then drop corn horn(anti spy) i also drop super chewy to really keep them away!

double agent is a spy killer and a great desteny!

luke is rather easy to pull up in the game, when you look for a planet look for luke or lukes back if you dont see one then you know it is in your force pile and then pull tell you pull one of them up, bam jedi testing is under way. it may take you a turn or two to start the testing but it rocks in the later part of the game.

advance preperation V, great desteny and you can retrieve a better lost card if needed or if you go with the blow up the death star adiea then there ya have it. death star decks seem to show up more often then you would think, never hurts to make them hurt!

naked threepio great for tracking those hi destiny! lukes saber you can pull it and addes to the jedi training and wy not drain a little while you there!

Tibrin, you can get ridd of three HI destiny cards for another good lost card, then tempt a jedi test, you most likely will pass so you take those three HI destiny and put then in your used pile, and track them.

Tat ep1 well you move for free and the dark side gets only one destiny,mabey.

aquaris, you get majer force! and the dabobah swamp,after you have destroid space you can recycle those shippes to give you more force, if you have time before you win!
